title: Biology 10 · Anchor Item Misconception Map
coveragePolicy: reviewed-anchor-items; reviewed distractor mappings are used when present; unmapped items fall back to the shared reasoning-category remediation layer

bio-001.correctRationale: Polarity supports hydrogen bonding, cohesion, and adhesion.

distractors.rationale: Water has mass; capillary action is explained by intermolecular interactions, not absence of mass.
Approximate neutrality does not explain cohesion or adhesion in narrow vessels.
Water contains no carbon, and carbon content is not the cause of capillary action.

bio-002.correctRationale: High temperature can disrupt protein structure and active-site geometry.

distractors.rationale: Heating does not inherently remove substrate; the central issue is enzyme structure and function.
Heat does not transform proteins into DNA; these are chemically distinct macromolecules.
Temperature effects on enzyme activity are not explained by changing chromosome number.

bio-003.correctRationale: A high surface-area-to-volume ratio provides more exchange surface relative to cellular demand.

distractors.rationale: Chromosome number is not determined by surface-area-to-volume ratio.
Efficient exchange does not eliminate ATP requirements for cellular processes.
Surface-area-to-volume constraints become harder, not irrelevant, as cells grow.

bio-004.correctRationale: Osmosis is water movement across a selectively permeable membrane.

distractors.rationale: Active solute transport requires energy and is not osmosis.
Cell division is a reproductive/growth process, not membrane water transport.
Protein synthesis occurs through transcription/translation, not osmosis.

bio-005.correctRationale: Mitochondria carry out major stages of aerobic cellular respiration and ATP production.

distractors.rationale: The Golgi modifies and sorts cellular products; it is not the main site of aerobic ATP production.
The nucleus stores and regulates genetic information rather than performing aerobic respiration.
Lysosomes digest materials; they are not the primary organelles for aerobic ATP production.

bio-006.correctRationale: Photosynthesis transforms light energy into chemical energy stored in organic molecules.

distractors.rationale: Photosynthesis does not primarily convert chemical energy into sound.
Carbon atoms are rearranged and conserved; they are not destroyed by photosynthesis.
Photosynthesis does not eliminate entropy; living systems operate within thermodynamic constraints.

bio-007.correctRationale: Products of photosynthesis and respiration can serve as reactants in the complementary pathway.

distractors.rationale: Photosynthesis is not an animal-only process, and respiration occurs broadly across organisms.
Both photosynthesis and cellular respiration involve electron-transfer/redox processes.
These pathways rearrange matter; they do not create atoms from nothing.

bio-008.correctRationale: ATP couples energy-releasing reactions to energy-requiring cellular work.

distractors.rationale: Many biological molecules contain phosphorus; ATP's role comes from its chemistry and coupling function.
Hereditary information is stored primarily in nucleic-acid sequence, not ATP.
ATP supplies usable energy but does not replace catalytic proteins such as enzymes.

bio-009.correctRationale: Receptors recognize particular signals and initiate specific response pathways.

distractors.rationale: DNA replication is performed by replication machinery, not receptor proteins.
Receptors are membrane/signaling proteins; they do not manufacture every membrane lipid.
Receptor specificity helps distinguish signals rather than making them identical.

bio-010.correctRationale: Negative feedback reduces deviations from a regulated range.

distractors.rationale: Amplifying a deviation characterizes positive-feedback behavior, not negative feedback.
Homeostasis is dynamic regulation, not the absence of biological change.
Feedback regulation does not work by changing chromosome number.

bio-011.correctRationale: Mitosis usually produces two daughter cells that retain the parental chromosome number.

distractors.rationale: Four genetically varied haploid products are characteristic of meiosis, not mitosis.
Gamete production is associated with meiosis; mitosis supports growth and tissue maintenance.
Independent assortment is a meiotic source of variation, not a normal consequence of mitosis.

bio-012.correctRationale: Mitotic index is the fraction of observed cells that are in mitosis.

distractors.rationale: A high mitotic index indicates many cells are dividing, not that every cell is mutated.
Mitotic index measures cell division frequency, not photosynthetic rate.
Mitotic index specifically concerns mitosis, not meiosis.

bio-013.correctRationale: Crossing over recombines homologous chromosomes and increases genetic variation among gametes.

distractors.rationale: Crossing over exchanges corresponding DNA segments; it does not remove all DNA.
Crossing over tends to increase, not erase, genetic differences among gametes.
Recombination changes allele combinations without doubling chromosome number.

bio-014.correctRationale: A Punnett square represents probabilities under a genetic model, not guaranteed family outcomes.

distractors.rationale: Probability models do not guarantee the genotype or phenotype of a particular child.
Punnett squares model allele inheritance, not all environmental effects.
A Punnett square tracks selected alleles and does not reconstruct an organism's full DNA sequence.

bio-015.correctRationale: Polygenic traits are influenced by multiple genes and often by environmental context.

distractors.rationale: By definition, polygenic traits involve contributions from multiple genes.
Polygenic traits do have genetic contributions even when environment also matters.
Polygenic inheritance is not restricted to mitochondrial DNA.

bio-016.correctRationale: Complementary base pairing lets each parental DNA strand serve as a template for a new partner.

distractors.rationale: DNA replication adds nucleotides; proteins catalyze the process but do not replace nucleotide sequence.
RNA is abundant and essential in cells; this claim does not explain DNA replication.
Chromosomes are replicated rather than disappearing during S phase.

bio-017.correctRationale: Ribosomes read mRNA codons and assemble amino acids into a polypeptide.

distractors.rationale: Copying DNA into DNA is replication, not translation.
Ribosomes synthesize proteins; they are not general protein-digestion organelles.
Homologous chromosome separation occurs during meiosis, not at ribosomes.

bio-018.correctRationale: A mutation can be silent when codon redundancy leaves the encoded amino acid unchanged.

distractors.rationale: Removing chromosomes would be a major genomic alteration, not a silent point-level coding outcome.
Mutations are changes in genetic material; they are not defined as events outside DNA.
Mutational effects can be harmful, neutral, or beneficial; they do not always increase fitness.

bio-019.correctRationale: Different cell types can share nearly the same genome while expressing different sets of genes.

distractors.rationale: Most differentiated cells in one organism retain nearly the same DNA sequence; expression patterns differ.
Gene expression can respond to environmental and signaling conditions.
Ribosomes translate mRNA; they do not store genes.

bio-020.correctRationale: Responsible genomics requires privacy, consent, uncertainty communication, and misuse safeguards.

distractors.rationale: File size is a technical issue, not the main ethical responsibility in genomics.
Genetic predictions often contain uncertainty and should not be presented as perfectly certain.
Hiding methods undermines reproducibility, accountability, and informed interpretation.

bio-021.correctRationale: Independent evidence streams that converge on compatible relationships strengthen evolutionary inference.

distractors.rationale: Multiple independent evidence sources are stronger than repeated views of one diagram.
Molecular evidence is an important independent line of evidence for evolutionary relationships.
Strong scientific models generate testable expectations and predictions.

bio-022.correctRationale: Natural selection requires heritable variation and unequal reproductive success linked to that variation.

distractors.rationale: Individuals do not intentionally change inherited genes because they need a trait.
Selection depends on interactions between traits and environmental conditions.
If all variants reproduce equally, selection cannot favor one heritable variant over another.

bio-023.correctRationale: Allele frequency is the proportion of a specific allele among copies of that gene in a population.

distractors.rationale: Organelle number is a cellular property, not a population genetic frequency.
Enzyme rate measures biochemical activity, not allele prevalence.
Fossil age is a chronological measure, not allele frequency.

bio-024.correctRationale: Speciation centers on the evolution of reproductive isolation and lineage divergence.

distractors.rationale: Mitosis produces body cells; it does not by itself create reproductively isolated populations.
Photosynthesis is an energy-conversion process, not a mechanism of speciation.
Short-term weather change alone does not define lineage divergence or reproductive isolation.

bio-025.correctRationale: A phylogenetic tree is a testable model of hypothesized evolutionary relationships.

distractors.rationale: Phylogenies branch; they do not rank living groups on a ladder from lower to higher.
A phylogeny models lineage relationships, not the reproductive success of one individual.
Food webs represent ecological feeding relationships, not common ancestry.

bio-026.correctRationale: Energy transfer between trophic levels is inefficient and much usable energy dissipates as heat.

distractors.rationale: Matter is transformed and cycled; it does not simply disappear.
Predators obtain chemical energy from food; they do not create energy.
Producers store chemical energy that supports higher trophic levels.

bio-027.correctRationale: Matter cycles through reservoirs while usable energy flows through ecosystems and dissipates.

distractors.rationale: Atoms are conserved and recycled through ecosystems.
Matter moves through organisms and abiotic reservoirs such as air, water, and soil.
Carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, and water all move through atmospheric reservoirs.

bio-028.correctRationale: Carrying capacity is condition-dependent and reflects the population an environment can sustain.

distractors.rationale: Carrying capacity changes with resources, habitat, interactions, and environmental conditions.
Chromosome number is a genetic property, not a population support limit.
Mutation rate does not define environmental carrying capacity.

bio-029.correctRationale: Biodiversity can support resilience through functional and response diversity.

distractors.rationale: Response diversity means different species or functions can respond differently to disturbance.
Biodiversity may improve recovery but does not prevent all disturbance.
Evolution continues in diverse communities; biodiversity does not stop evolutionary change.

bio-030.correctRationale: Strong scientific claims connect evidence to reasoning and state uncertainty and limitations.

distractors.rationale: Scientific credibility improves when uncertainty and limits are stated transparently.
Relevant quantitative evidence can strengthen biological arguments.
Correlation alone does not establish a causal mechanism.

bio-031.correctRationale: Within-team precision is high, but the between-team difference suggests a possible systematic measurement difference that should be tested.

distractors.rationale: The within-team consistency and between-team offset point first to a possible measurement-system difference, not evidence that the specimen changed.
Pooling all values would hide the systematic difference between teams instead of testing it.
Discarding lower values without a pre-stated quality rule biases the dataset.
10 is the absolute change, not the percent change.
Using 10/50 gives 20%, but percent change is referenced to the original value.
40 is the starting quantity, not the percent change.

bio-033.correctRationale: Comparative physical behavior can support the role of polarity and hydrogen bonding.

distractors.rationale: Carbon content does not test hydrogen bonding or cohesion in water.
If all liquids behaved equally, that would not support a water-specific polarity explanation.
Water's cohesion is evidence for intermolecular attraction, not absence of it.

bio-034.correctRationale: Composition data support composition claims, not complete physiological conclusions.

distractors.rationale: A food label reports composition but cannot by itself establish complete biological effects.
Protein and carbohydrate are chemically distinct classes of biomolecules.
Lipids are carbon-containing organic molecules.

bio-035.correctRationale: Rate equals change divided by elapsed time: 18/3=6 and 54/3=18 units/min.

distractors.rationale: 18 and 54 are totals, not values divided by the 3-minute interval.
3 and 9 result from over-dividing rather than using change/time once.
Adding elapsed time to the totals does not compute a rate.

bio-036.correctRationale: The cell is 6/4=1.5 times the scale bar, so 1.5×20 μm=30 μm.

distractors.rationale: The cell is larger than the 4 cm scale bar on the print, so its actual size must exceed 20 μm, not shrink below it.
Using 20 μm directly ignores that the cell image is 1.5 times the scale-bar length.
Using 6×20 ignores the 4 cm reference length and overestimates the cell size.

bio-037.correctRationale: Smaller cubes have more surface area per unit volume.

distractors.rationale: As a cube grows, volume increases faster than surface area, so SA:V decreases.
Surface area and volume do not scale linearly with side length; doubling both abstractly misses the geometric relationship.
Removing the membrane eliminates the exchange boundary rather than improving a viable cell's SA:V.

bio-038.correctRationale: Multiple bacterial-like features provide converging evidence for endosymbiotic ancestry.

distractors.rationale: Being large would not specifically support bacterial ancestry.
Mitochondria occur broadly in eukaryotes, not only plants.
Mitochondria possess their own small genome but not the cell's nuclear chromosomes.

bio-039.correctRationale: Differential gene expression is central to cell specialization.

distractors.rationale: Differentiated cells generally retain the genome rather than deleting most genes.
Ribosomes translate RNA and do not rewrite genomic DNA.
Cell shape is an outcome of cellular programs, not a determinant of nucleotide order.

bio-040.correctRationale: A plateau is consistent with another factor becoming limiting or the system approaching capacity under those conditions.

distractors.rationale: A plateau means the measured rate stopped increasing under those conditions, not that photosynthesis ceased permanently.
Carbon atoms are conserved and rearranged, not destroyed.
The data show a plateau, not an obligatory decline with more light.

bio-041.correctRationale: 12 mL ÷ 6 min ÷ 2 g = 1 mL O₂ min⁻¹ g⁻¹.

distractors.rationale: 12/6=2 mL/min, but the result still must be divided by 2 g.
4 mL/min/g does not follow from dividing the measured oxygen use by both time and mass correctly.
12 mL is the unnormalized total, not a mass-specific rate.

bio-042.correctRationale: Tracking atoms checks conservation of matter across reaction models.

distractors.rationale: Energy flows and dissipates; atom accounting tests matter conservation, not energy recycling.
Atoms are rearranged through reactions and do not vanish.
Stoichiometric accounting is a model check and cannot replace experimental evidence.

bio-043.correctRationale: A: 3 mL/h/g; B: 2 mL/h/g, so A has the higher normalized rate.

distractors.rationale: B has the larger raw CO₂ output but also twice the mass; normalization reverses the comparison.
A=3 and B=2 mL/h/g, so the normalized rates are not equal.
Mass normalization is specifically what makes the two organisms comparable here.

bio-044.correctRationale: The graph supports a bounded response pattern, not a complete molecular mechanism.

distractors.rationale: A dose-response curve supports a response pattern but does not by itself prove the molecular mechanism.
The curve does not establish equal receptor abundance in every cell.
The graph cannot guarantee absence of side effects at higher doses.
8 is the absolute deviation, not the percentage relative to 50.
50 is the reference value, not the computed percent deviation.
58 is the peak measurement, not the percent deviation.

bio-046.correctRationale: Replication doubles DNA/chromatid count while chromosome count remains 8 until sister chromatids separate.

distractors.rationale: After S phase, each chromosome has two sister chromatids, so chromatids double.
DNA replication doubles chromatids/DNA amount but chromosome count remains 8 until chromatids separate.
This reverses what changes during S phase.

bio-047.correctRationale: A rescue-style comparison tests whether changing the suspected factor changes the phenotype in the predicted direction.

distractors.rationale: Visual contrast does not test whether the regulatory variant causes the phenotype.
Restating an association does not provide intervention-based causal evidence.
Removing the control makes causal interpretation weaker, not stronger.

bio-048.correctRationale: Data exclusions require transparent rules tied to measurement quality or design, not preferred conclusions.

distractors.rationale: Removing inconvenient data without a pre-stated rule is selective reporting.
Changing the hypothesis only after seeing results risks post hoc reasoning.
Rounding should follow measurement rules, not be used to force agreement with expectations.
10 comes from 2×5, but independent assortment combinations follow 2^n.
25 comes from 5², not the 2^n chromosome-combination model.
64 is 2^6 and overcounts one homologous pair.

bio-050.correctRationale: The four equally likely genotype cells are AA, Aa, Aa, aa.

distractors.rationale: Two of four cells are Aa, but only aa is the recessive homozygote.
3/4 corresponds to the expected dominant phenotype fraction, not aa genotype.
Aa × Aa produces a distribution of genotypes, not all aa.
